quest.title: The Shadows Deepen
quest.description: Having been invited to serve as instructors at the Adventurers' Guild winter camp, you reach an agreement with Albedo, who is also conducting research in the mountains, to find out what happened here. The path towards the truth is winding and long, and you keep encountering new things...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo, we're here!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How is your investigation going?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...Your faces say that, perhaps, you haven't turned up anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We investigated all over the mountain, actually. But we didn't see anyone that looked like you, or hear of anyone else meeting you...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This is not unexpected. I haven't made much progress, either. He appears to know that we are looking for him, and has opted to lie low for the time being.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Or maybe he has always operated discreetly.)

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Still, there is one thing I found. I discovered footprints on some parts of the mountain, and although they were a little covered by the snow, I could tell they had been left by someone of a similar size to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The footprints were quite numerous, so I believe my next step will be to rule out each of the adventurers active on Dragonspine one by one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can help with that. We have plenty of contact with the adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So now we...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah! What was that!?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It came from that direction.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be the impostor?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go check it out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, let's hurry!

talks.objective: Follow the source of the voice

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, did you see that? Did those rocks shake just now?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Phew. That was most unfortunate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are you guys doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd assume it was some sort of bad luck.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I have to agree. We've been wandering this area for days...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: We ran into Pallad earlier. You know, the, uh... kind of a reckless sort of guy? You know the one? Anyway, he said he was unlucky, so I gave him some adventuring survival tips...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: After that, he disappeared to rejoin the training camp.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, wait... are you saying that after all this time, you still haven't made it back to the base camp?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Haha... Well, as you can see...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: It was nothing, really. We just hit a few landslides and snowdrifts, and took a few downhill tumbles, you know the deal.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: They sound like unforgettable life events to me.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Anyway... You're correct, we haven't made it to the base camp yet. We have had extraordinarily poor luck over the last few days, almost as if a sinister force has been trying to thwart our every move.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Fortunately, I made advance arrangements for Gerald to remain in a safe location and conduct some basic physical training exercises.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... I'm the one to blame for all this. I've always had bad luck and it always rubs off on everyone around me...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Sorry to create so much extra trouble for everyone... *sigh*.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I don't know what to say... Maybe this is the awesome power of fate — the scary kind, I mean.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I agree.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I am not scared to be around you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, we're just used to it now! Besides, it's not like we have the most amazing luck ourselves...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Really? I think you guys have way better luck than I do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... what can we do about that? Oh, Paimon knows, how about Paimon shares some of her luck with you!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You're welcome to a bit of mine, too! Although, if the last few days are anything to go by, it seems in pretty short supply at the moment...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Take some of mine, too.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: ...You guys...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Aww... Thanks. With a little luck from everyone combined, we'll make it down this mountain for sure!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yeah, you bet!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Let me flip a Treasure Hoarder Insignia to test it out... Alright! It's tails, the opposite of what I guessed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you can predict your fortune this way? But why are you so happy that you got it wrong?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: It has two sides, so there is a 50-50 chance of me getting it correct.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Luck all comes down to probability, too. So as long as I use up all the bad luck, everything else will go smoothly!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Guessing wrong when I flip an insignia is one way to use up some of the bad luck. So the probability of having some good luck in the near future just got a little higher.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, he's making no sense at all... why aren't you calling him out!?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Guys, I guessed wrong in my insignia flip, which means we should be able to make it back to camp!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's not sure that's how it works.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Lemme try. It's this way, right?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Whoa!!! Ouch... Ow, my butt...! What is this shard of ice doing here!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: How truly miraculous... This is a miracle of misfortune.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I don't usually believe in luck, but Bennett makes the best case for it I've ever seen.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Amber, if you are ever required to partner with Bennett in your future work and you encounter anything like this again, do not take any rash action. Wait for me and I will come to support you.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Huh? Y—Yes, of course...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Everyone must be exhausted...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Now that you mention it, I do feel a little tired... Trekking in the mountains has a way of wearing you out.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Since everyone is tired, why not take a rest in my camp?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's so sleepy... A nice bowl of hot soup and a good sleep would sure be welcome right now...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yawn... Suddenly I'm kinda sleepy, too...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Amber will fall asleep in the snow if we keep going much longer... Come on, let's move! We shall head to Albedo's camp and get some rest, take stock of our supplies, and decide how to get off this mountain.

choices.text: I'm actually polite to most people.
It has nothing to do with fate.

talks.objective: Follow the source of the voice

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Here we are. Make yourselves comfortable.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Oh... I forgot, I don't have that many chairs. Please wait a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's he doing? Painting?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: He is!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: He is painting a chair... Wait, alchemy can turn paintings into objects!? How is this possible?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: My paintings are like blueprints — alchemy simply enables me to omit the manufacturing part of the process. It's an elementary-level technique.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: With enough research and experimentation, this same technique can even be used to create living beings.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Whoa... Well, since you can magically produce chairs, can I have one with a backrest?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have a stool.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: No problem. How many of you want backrests?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Me!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Me! Me!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...I'll also take one with a backrest, if you please.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can Paimon have a chair that comes with a juicer?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A whole chair is way too big for you, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still beats squeezing onto a stool with you! Hmph!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Cool, we have chairs now! Haha, this is so comfortable! Makes me want to stay the night here!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You're very welcome to stay overnight, if you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: There's still some time before dinner. Get some rest, everyone. I'll tend the stove.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey now, we can't be letting you do all the work! I can help, please, put me to work!

talks.objective: Wait until nighttime (18:00 – 06:00 the next day)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright. Let's start with the head! Now, {NICKNAME}, in your mind's eye, what is written on Paimon's face?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Is that how Paimon really looks to you? Huh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay forget it, we can come back to that. Let's move onto the body! C'mon! Paint what you see when you look at Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Paimon's starting to feel like this is not going to turn out so great... Now Paimon's getting nervous...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Done.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lemme see, let Paimon see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aah! What is this!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Not bad, right? I'm pretty happy with it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why, you... how could... Huh. Paimon is lost for words! The brushwork is smooth and the composition seems professional-quality — you had no problems there, so what the heck happened with the face, huh!? Explain that stupid expression! Explain it!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: ...Smooth... Professional-quality...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And those eyes! Those boring, lifeless eyes! Where is the soul!!!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Traveler, have you previously received any education in the fine arts?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, really? So it's just a hobby then? Well that sure explains a lot! There's no way you would have made Paimon look like this if you'd had any amount of formal training.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I was just trying to convey how special you are.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Fascinating.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Paimon, if this is not to your liking, I can make a few amendments. Traveler, what do you think?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Please. And thank you.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Alright then.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Paimon, is this better?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's... It's...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a total ground-up overhaul, that's what it is! It's soooo pretty... is that really what Paimon looks like...?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Adding flourish to the finished piece is an essential component of what makes art, art.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This is not to say that you differ from the painting on a fundamental level. Rather, that the real you and the you in the painting present two different styles of beauty.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: You remain the core reference point for the painting. So, Paimon, you can put your misgivings aside and hang this painting wherever you like.

choices.text: Now I see the gap in our painting talents.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... Thanks, Albedo!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I merely added a flourish here and there. You should be thanking the Traveler.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: (In truth, "ground-up overhaul" is more or less an accurate description.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The more Paimon looks at it, the more she likes it... Hehe, great! Paimon has a portrait painting!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's gonna show this off to everyone!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon looks so happy. Thank you.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It's nothing. I can paint you next time, if you'd like. You can hang it in your home as a souvenir.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I rarely entertain so many guests at my camp. It's lively — a little noisy, even. But I don't dislike it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Liveliness is a rare thing here on Dragonspine.
Eula! EUUULAAA! Where are you!!!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Amber, we're here!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Eula! Oh, and Traveler, Paimon, Albedo, and Bennett, you're all together! Great!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Bennett, I'm glad I ran into you here. Cyrus was telling me you still hadn't shown up. He was getting worried you might've run into some trouble.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Haha... Yeah, I ran into a little trouble... thanks for your concern.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Sure thing. Well, that now that I've found you, let's go check in with Cyrus.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But before that — has something come up? How come you're all gathered here together? Need any help?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Between us, there have been a few minor incidents. But nothing I haven't already dealt with.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh! Uh, yeah, hehe, it's my fault really, all because of my bad luck. But everything is fine now!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: So, it's all set then? Great. Shall we head back down together? I did say I'd bring Bennett back if I saw him.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Sure, I'm ready to go!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: ...Very well. Let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then there were three.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Traveler, can we talk somewhere else? There is something I need to tell you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Let's go to my camp.

choices.text: This was my trial by fire as an artist.
No, but... art comes from the heart, so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? You pour your heart on the page, and THIS is what comes out!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I just wanted to convey how special you are.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Special"? Huh... You seriously think "special" is supposed to look this ugly? Paimon's not convinced... but Paimon is struggling to come up with a come back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When will dinner be?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It's almost ready now. Traveler, please light the campfire and gather everyone for dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I wonder if there's anything I can do to help out... ?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh, you mean Gerald? I heard that Eula developed a whole training program for him.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: He might be new, but I bet he'll improve pretty quickly with a mentor like that.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: *sigh* I feel bad, it's hard knowing that I've been causing so much trouble for everyone.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Being a little unlucky is usually no big deal for me. But in a place like this, it makes me worry that something really bad might come of it...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: No, wait, I shouldn't have said that. I might have actually jinxed it now.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Haha, you know me, same old Bennett... unlucky as ever.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But as long as bad luck doesn't break me, I'll always get back up again.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Especially on a cool adventure like this one. I gotta make the most of it!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Hehe, sorry for dragging you guys into another situation.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I didn't use to know any of these knights very well, but after spending some time with them on this trip, it's really opened my eyes to my own shortcomings.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: They're all so talented and kind. I have a lot to learn from them.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh yeah — you gotta tell me sometime how you managed to make friends with so many talented people!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Okay, cool. Make sure you eat plenty when dinner's ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay, dinner's ready!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Food's ready, everyone! Come on, let's eat!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I made a few dishes based on some popular Mondstadt recipes. This is no Good Hunter, but there should be enough to go around.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Please, help yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Wow, smells great! Don't mind if I do!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Wait, don't steal all the fried vegetables. Leave some for me! ...Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah... Paimon's full. What a great meal!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Albedo, you're too modest. These dishes are as good as anything you'd find in a top restaurant. Are all alchemists so good at cooking?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: You may be onto something there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right? Paimon thinks so, too! It's his lab manner that gives it away — the kind of guy who holds a potion bottle as steady as a rock isn't the kind of guy who's gonna be slapdash with his salt and pepper.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Actually, that makes a lot of sense!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I'm so sleepy after all that food... zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Did Bennett fall asleep sitting up? He must be totally wiped out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been a tough few days.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: The way he's sleeping is so... alert. I'm impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Zzz... zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He seems to be in a deep sleep. Paimon wonders if he sleep talks?

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Ugh... Ugh, no dad, no apples for me... I want Sticky Honey Roast and Fisherman's Toast...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Sticky Honey Roast... That's your favorite, isn't it, Amber?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hmm, sure is! Give me a Sticky Honey Roast from Good Hunter any day!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I used to take Eula to Good Hunter a lot back when we first met. Before long, Sara would start cooking our usual orders as soon as she saw us coming.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: She said we ordered the same things so often that it was practically muscle memory by that point! Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: She also said that if everyone in Mondstadt ordered like we do, her job would be so much easier. All she'd have to do is to memorize everyone's favorites...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Always eating together... Aw, it's nice that you two are so close.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon always eat together, too. It's a sure sign of true friendship!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Two people simply sharing a meal says nothing either way about the relationship between them.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: That depends if it's a one-off meal or a regular occurrence.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He's not wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! Paimon just noticed something! Whenever Eula doesn't want to admit to something, she raises her chin or puts her hands on her hips.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ah, you've all picked up on that. Didn't know Eula's tells were so easy to spot.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: We are done here, yes? I am free to go, am I not?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Please excuse me. I have a frozen lake I need to be at.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You're going for an ice bath at this time of the night? W—Wait up, don't go without me!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I thought you wanted to get some sleep? So maybe you should stay here and rest.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: No, I should come with you. It's late, and it's dark, and you're not good with directions like I am. Come on, let's go together.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An ice bath...? Whew, rather them than Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Zzz... so much... roast meat... zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Oh... hey dad... I'm doing alright... I'm the leader of my own adventure team now... Zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Bennett really is a sleep talker.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, looks like we got some downtime now!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Alright you two, time to paint.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Have you decided what to paint?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, like you even need to ask! It's obviously going to be Paimon.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Okay. Paimon it is.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Sure. But we should move elsewhere. We're likely to disturb Bennett's sleep if we stay here, so let's go outside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okie-dokie! Alright, grab your easel, paper, brushes, and paints, don't leave anything behind!

choices.text: Time for me to show what I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Let's paint here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Allow Paimon to adopt an elegant pose for your artistic reference!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! What's that look for? Cut the attitude and start putting your perfect Paimon down on the page! You'd better take this seriously, 'cause this is going on Paimon's wall!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Confidence is a good thing. Those to whom it is endowed do well to flaunt it. I'm looking forward to the finished piece.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Dragonspine...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Even now, I don't believe I have fully grasped the nature of the threat that Dragonspine poses.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But I will endeavor to keep you safe. That much you can trust in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you holding up?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hah. I wish I could simply respond with, "I'm fine."

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But you are a true friend to me, so I should be honest with you.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Recently, certain questions have been occupying my mind... questions about the nature of life, and creation.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: However, I feel that rushing into a discussion with you on these topics before my ideas on them are fully formulated will bring you far more confusion than clarity.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: So I will wait till my thoughts are clear in my own head before I share them with you. Until then, please forgive me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About what happened today...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. A chance like this to gather around the fire and chat into the night is a rare and precious one for me.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I won't participate in the conversation much. It's just a habit of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But please know that I am enjoying the atmosphere all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Of course, I'm happy to continue chatting with you if you'd like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This is my camp, but let's not get bogged down in technicalities. I want you to be able to relax and make yourself at home here.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Zzz... zzz...

response.speaker: Observe Bennett.
response.text: Bennett is sleeping soundly with his eyes tightly shut...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Huh... Hey! Paimon, no, don't touch that!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...What the heck?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Don't touch that mechanism! Or you'll... fall down... ugh, oh well, never mind...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhhh! What the heck is this guy dreaming about!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It's so nice and warm here...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Joel's been doing pretty good. Having people to play with has put him in a good mood.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I'll tell you what though, he seems to have even more stamina than me!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: So long as they're playing, kids always seem to have endless amounts of energy.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: It's more dangerous up here than I thought.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: In a hostile environment like this, even a knight of Favonius has to keep their eyes open and keep their wits about them at all times.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Still, this has been a pretty unique adventure for me. It's definitely been worth it.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: You know, when I was keeping Joel company, I started missing my grandfather really bad...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: After he disappeared, I never saw him again. I have no idea how he's doing.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: But at least what I can do is focus on being a great Outrider! If I can do that well, I know he'd be proud.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, all that? Ah, don't worry about it.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Eula is a good person. She might not show it, but she'd never let that kind of stuff get to her.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: As for Bennett, he seems like the kind of guy who can keep his spirits up when things aren't going well.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I feel bad for having to ask so much of Albedo, though...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Still, it's kinda nice to have everyone together like this, so... yay for silver linings.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Sure thing. Bet you're tired as well? You should get some rest, too.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: This is quite cozy... for Dragonspine, I'm pleasantly surprised.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I gave it a try, and I actually quite enjoyed it.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But Amber said the snowman I made was too artistic... apparently, the conventional style is more rotund in appearance.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I couldn't tell if she was complimenting me or mocking me. Either way, I'm not about to let it go.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I'm quite familiar with Dragonspine by now.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: But this time, I have a newcomer to worry about, and I am traveling in a group with Amber and the others. Not things I'm terribly well accustomed to.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Still, I've taken the job, so of course I'll do what's asked of me to the fullest of my ability. I'll settle this score once this is all over.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Me? I'm coping perfectly well. I don't need looking after.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: You should talk to Amber and Bennett. They're not as well acquainted with Dragonspine as I am.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Seeing how much you can find to talk about even with Albedo, you must be quite the conversationalist. So put that skill to good use — teach them all how to survive on Dragonspine. I'm sure this is well within your capability, no?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If you're talking about Bennett's situation, I think I'm used to it now. It's hardly the end of the world.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Don't ruminate on it. Take this chance to get some proper rest. The nights are long on Dragonspine.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: *sigh* A glass of ice-cold wine would not go amiss right now.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Don't mind me. Just do whatever you like.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Pace yourself, dinner could be a while... I still have a few things to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the paint...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I didn't expect you to be so interested in paint.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I once tried grinding Mist Flowers into powder and mixing it with white paint to replicate the sparkle of snowflakes.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The end result was quite satisfactory. But works that use this kind of paint need to be stored carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If you want to try it for yourself, I can help you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The time has come! Let's go meet Albedo at the camp!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Rocks? Ah! And what are these boars also doing here!?
